name: Penetrating Oil Finishes in Sammamish: Pros, Cons, and Maintenance Reality
title-tag: Penetrating Oil Floor Finish: A Sammamish, WA Guide
meta-description: Hardwax oil vs waterborne finish for Sammamish floors: the natural matte look, invisible scratch repair, and the re-oiling schedule nobody quotes you.
post-summary: February 10, 2027 · Penetrating hardwax oil cures inside the wood instead of forming a film, which buys a dead-matte natural floor and scratch repairs that blend invisibly. The trade is a maintenance schedule that never ends and less tolerance for standing water. Where it fits on the Sammamish plateau — especially over thin engineered wear layers — and where waterborne still wins.
